scenarios.criterion: apps/mock-api/data/reagent-sites.json MUST hold exactly the eight sites in docs/specs/reagent-map-spec/acceptance-criteria.json's seed.reagentSites, each with an id, name, lat and lng.
scenarios.name: The seeded reagent sites match the specification exactly
given: The reagent sites seed data file has been created for the mock API
when: The seed data is compared against the specification's seed list of reagent sites
then: Exactly eight reagent sites are present
Each site has an id, a name, a latitude, and a longitude
Every site's id, name, latitude, and longitude matches the specification's seed list

scenarios.criterion: GET /api/reagent-sites MUST return all eight sites with their positions unchanged, whether or not the request carries a session (spec AC1; features/reagent-map/reagent-sites.feature @AC1 @level-api).
scenarios.name: A request with no session still receives all reagent sites at their original positions
given: No session is present on the request
when: A client requests the list of reagent sites
then: The response contains all eight reagent sites
Every site's position is unchanged from the seed data

scenarios.criterion: GET /api/reagent-sites MUST return all eight sites with their positions unchanged, whether or not the request carries a session (spec AC1; features/reagent-map/reagent-sites.feature @AC1 @level-api).
scenarios.name: A request with a valid session receives all reagent sites at their original positions
given: A client holds a valid session
when: The client requests the list of reagent sites
then: The response contains all eight reagent sites
Every site's position is unchanged from the seed data

scenarios.criterion: GET /api/reagent-sites MUST return all eight sites with their positions unchanged, whether or not the request carries a session (spec AC1; features/reagent-map/reagent-sites.feature @AC1 @level-api).
scenarios.name: A request with an invalid or garbage session still receives all reagent sites at their original positions
given: A client holds an invalid or garbage session credential
when: The client requests the list of reagent sites
then: The response contains all eight reagent sites

The request is not rejected on account of the session credential

scenarios.criterion: apps/mock-api MUST run its tests through Node's built-in node:test, with no new dependency, via a test script in apps/mock-api/package.json.
scenarios.name: The mock API's test suite runs on Node's built-in test runner with no added dependency
given: The mock API project as delivered
when: The test script declared in apps/mock-api/package.json is run
then: The suite executes using Node's built-in node:test runner
No new test-framework dependency has been added to run it

when: The change is reviewed for complexity, test coverage, and file scope
